plan.title: Package Claude Code and Codex hook integration with explicit support and verification boundaries

criteria.description: Shared missing, pass, edited-input stale and NOT VERIFIED scenarios produce the documented hook decisions for validated Claude Code and Codex payload fixtures; malformed supported payloads cannot silently bypass protected mutations.

Codex apply_patch add, update, delete and move operations targeting protected state are rejected, including multi-file and relative-path patches, while ordinary source edits and read-only operations remain allowed.

Version-scoped integration templates parse, select supported event and tool names, invoke the checked binary contract, and leave user/global settings untouched; installation and removal instructions preserve unrelated settings.

limitations: Hook support is version-scoped to locally inspected agent schemas/runtime behavior; a replayed payload is not proof of a live agent integration.

NARU-013 remains incomplete until required Claude Code and Codex live missing/pass/stale/NOT VERIFIED evidence is recorded with agent version, code revision, isolation and observed decisions. Existing historical Claude evidence is not silently relabeled as current verification.

Prepare synthetic temporary test projects and launch instructions before requesting any still-required approval for paid/subscription agent sessions or persistent settings changes. No automatic paid agent invocation, user configuration overwrite, install, push, tag or release.
PreToolUse parsing is a guard rail rather than a filesystem security boundary. Agent-disabled hooks and direct same-user tampering remain outside the guarantee; CI reruns remain authoritative.
No policy-to-Stop integration, relay, orchestration product or expansion of platform runtime claims; these belong to later tasks.
Static analysis and task-gate tests are necessary but do not replace manual live-session acceptance. Do not close the task while a required live-session condition remains unverified.
